work_orders.title: U2 HI_JACKET_TEMP nuisance trips: suspect RTD or loose wiring

notes.text: 11/07: U2 tripped HI_JACKET_TEMP at 201F. Gauge looked normal by the time I got there. Reset and ran.
11/11: Same trip again. Reading jumps up and drops right back in 2-3 min, too fast for real jacket water. Probably the RTD.
11/14: Tripped twice today. Topped off U2 coolant (about 2 gal) while I was there. I&E scheduled Monday to replace the RTD and check wiring.
11/20 day shift: Per Rick, if U2 nuisance-trips tonight it's OK to bypass HI_JACKET_TEMP and keep it running. Watch the temp.

dispatch_jobs.reason: U2 HI_JACKET_TEMP trip (WO-3402). Reading spiked 177->195->202 then fell to 175 in 3 min, but U2 had run ~13F warmer than U1/U3 for 20 min before. Need to verify RTD vs. real coolant loss/overheat (2 gal top-off on 11/14). PLC refused bypass. Roads iced.
